description: Resolve a Ukrainian company or public buyer NAME to its EDRPOU code, using ProZorro's organization index (keyless). This is the entry point for supplier due diligence: a user knows the company's name, but prozorro_search_tenders filters by EDRPOU — call this first, then pass the returned `edrpou` as `tenderer` (supplier side) or `buyer` to get that company's full tender history.

name.description: Company or buyer name, Ukrainian recommended.

role.description: "tenderer" for suppliers/bidders (default), or "buyer" for procuring entities.

name: prozorro_search_organizations
title: Prozorro Search Organizations
